fields.notes:
No sign-in is required, and the app works fully offline.

To try it: type or paste text in the left pane. It translates as you type (or press Command-Return). Pick languages from the two menus in the toolbar. Languages not yet downloaded show a download prompt from macOS.

The free version includes 5 translations a day. Pro (Yearly subscription or Lifetime purchase) removes the limit; open it from Translate Offline › Unlock Pro… or the card at the bottom of the sidebar.

Settings › General › Quality offers "Best quality", which uses the Apple Intelligence translation models on Macs where Apple Intelligence is turned on. It also runs on-device and offline.

fields.description:
Translate Offline translates text right on your Mac, with no internet connection needed. Your words never leave your computer.

Type or paste, and the translation appears as you type. It's made for the moments you can't count on Wi-Fi: hotel rooms, flights, trains, and travel abroad.

• Works offline: translation runs on your Mac, even with Wi-Fi off
• Private by design: nothing you type is uploaded anywhere
• Translates as you type, or press Command-Return
• Pronunciation for languages like Japanese and Chinese, plus read-aloud
• Recent and Saved: find past translations fast and keep the phrases you reuse
• Best quality: on Macs with Apple Intelligence, get more natural translations, still offline
• Made for Mac: menu bar commands, keyboard shortcuts, and light and dark mode

Languages include English, Arabic, Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, and more. Download the ones you need once, from System Settings or right in the app.

Translate Offline is free with 5 translations a day. Translate Offline Pro removes the daily limit, keeps up to 500 translations in Recent instead of 10, and saves unlimited phrases instead of 10. Choose a yearly subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

The yearly subscription renews automatically unless it's cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://mekarya.studio/privacy/translate-offline

Questions or ideas? Contact support using the link below.

fields.whatsNew:
A redesigned Translate Offline

• Translates as you type, in a new window with a sidebar
• Recent and Saved: find past translations and keep the phrases you reuse
• Pronunciation for languages like Japanese and Chinese, plus read-aloud
• Best quality: on Macs with Apple Intelligence, more natural translations, still fully offline
• Settings › Languages shows exactly which languages are on your Mac, with one-click downloads
• New Settings for appearance, translation quality, speaking speed, and history
• Full menu bar commands and keyboard shortcuts

Translate Offline is now free with 5 translations a day, and Pro removes the limit. Bought the app before this update? Thank you: Pro is already yours.
